name: Surprising Strategy (Mythic)
body:
You bewilder your opponent in battle with your fast and precise maneuvers.

Prerequisite(s): Surprising Strategy

Benefit(s): You add ½ your mythic tier to your CMB for dirty trick, disarm, or sunder attempts when you successfully parry an attack (minimum +1). In addition, you can attempt any other combat maneuver allowed by the circumstances, applying the benefits of the non-mythic Surprising Strategy feat.
